calibration.method: trimmed orthogonal similarity fit of complete ACC on-track lap to uniform metric GeoJSON samples
calibration.reference: Public Sunset Monza acc-native-world-xz, 2026-10-24; 263 geometry points, no identities retained
calibration.note: Approximate alignment of circuit geometry and a driven racing line. Vehicles retain world X/Z; no snapping onto the centerline. Pit and finish anchors are not supplied by this GeoJSON.
